ui-body.purpose: All interface text at 13px/20px in Hanken Grotesk.

panel-title.purpose: h2 in a panel header row.

call-label.purpose: Typed lines of a call-number label in Courier Prime; call numbers and accession codes only.

shadows.name: label-sticker
shadows.purpose: A 1px drop that makes a call-number label read as a sticker.

shadows.name: palette-overlay
shadows.purpose: The floating command palette over a 60% ink scrim. No other element carries a shadow.

motion.name: palette-in
motion.purpose: Command palette entrance: fade, 6px rise, 0.985 to 1 scale. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: color-transition
motion.purpose: Hover and active fills on buttons, nav rows and the search trigger.

components.name: Call-Number Label
components.description: The signature component: a white label with a Dewey class band and typed Courier Prime lines.
components.css: .ds-call-label { position: relative; display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; flex: none; min-width: 50px; width: max-content; min-height: 48px; padding: 8px 6px 4px 5px; background: var(--label-stock, #ffffff); border: 1px solid var(--label-edge, #c5ccd6); border-top: 0; border-radius: 0 0 3px 3px; box-shadow: 0 1px 1px rgb(22 32 46 / 0.12); color: var(--label-ink, #111111); font: 700 10.5px/12px 'Courier Prime', 'Courier New', monospace; letter-spacing: 0.2px; } .ds-call-label::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0 -1px auto -1px; height: 5px; background: var(--cls, #8e9cb1); border-radius: 2px 2px 0 0; } .ds-call-label > span { display: block; min-height: 12px; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-call-label > span + span { font-weight: 400; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single main action of a panel or page, top right.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--primary, #16202e); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--primary, #16202e); color: var(--primary-fg, #ffffff); font: 600 13px/20px 'Hanken Grotesk Variable', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 150ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-primary:active { opacity: 0.8; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #3a6fb5); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Default button: bordered, on the work surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #c3cbd6); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--surface, #ffffff); color: var(--fg, #16202e); font: 500 13px/20px 'Hanken Grotesk Variable', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--band, #f6f8fb); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: var(--line, #dfe4ea); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #3a6fb5); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Quiet tertiary action without a border.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--muted, #5b6676); font: 500 13px/20px 'Hanken Grotesk Variable', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms, color 150ms; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--band, #f6f8fb); color: var(--fg, #16202e); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #3a6fb5); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Rail Navigation Item
components.description: Text-only item on the ink rail. Active is fill plus bold white text, no side marker.
components.html: CatalogueDashboard
components.css: .ds-rail { width: 216px; padding: 8px; background: var(--ink, #16202e); } .ds-nav { display: block; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 6px; color: var(--rail-text, #c9d2de); font: 400 13px/32px 'Hanken Grotesk Variable', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 150ms, color 150ms; } .ds-nav:hover { background: var(--ink-2, #222f42); color: #ffffff; } .ds-nav-active { background: var(--ink-2, #222f42); color: #ffffff; font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #3a6fb5); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search Trigger
components.description: Search-first control in the ink top bar that opens the command palette with Ctrl K.
components.css: .ds-search { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: 420px; height: 36px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid var(--ink-3, #2f3f56); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--ink-2, #222f42); color: var(--rail-field-text, #a4b1c4); font: 400 13px/20px 'Hanken Grotesk Variable', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms; } .ds-search:hover { border-color: var(--rail-line-strong, #44566f); } .ds-search-text { flex: 1; text-align: left; } .ds-kbd { padding: 0 6px; border: 1px solid var(--rail-line-strong, #44566f); border-radius: 4px; color: var(--rail-text, #c9d2de); font: 400 11px/18px 'Hanken Grotesk Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-search:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #3a6fb5); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Chips
components.description: Neutral, overdue and fine chips. Red and amber appear only for overdue and fines.
components.html: Issued Overdue 4 days Fine due
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; padding: 0 8px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #c3cbd6); border-radius: 4px; color: var(--fg, #16202e); font: 500 12px/20px 'Hanken Grotesk Variable', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-chip-overdue { border-width: 1.5px; border-color: var(--danger, #c2171d); background: var(--surface, #ffffff); color: var(--danger, #c2171d); font-weight: 700; } .ds-chip-fine { border-color: rgb(138 90 0 / 0.4); background: var(--warn-bg, #fff6dc); color: var(--warn, #8a5a00); font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Panel
components.description: Flat bordered container with a titled header row.
components.html:
System status

Local

Every record lives in the data folder on this computer.
components.css: .ds-panel { width: 320px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #dfe4ea); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--surface, #ffffff); color: var(--fg, #16202e); font: 400 13px/20px 'Hanken Grotesk Variable', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-panel-head { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding: 12px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #dfe4ea); } .ds-panel-title { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-panel-aside { font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted, #5b6676); } .ds-panel-body { margin: 0; padding: 12px 16px; color: var(--muted, #5b6676); }

narrative.overview:
A library tool should look like the shelf it serves. Every book in a library is identified by a stacked call-number label that a librarian already reads at a glance, so that label is the signature of the whole system: a white sticker with a coloured Dewey class band across its top and typed lines beneath. Everything else is built to stay out of its way. A deep shelf-ink frame (rail and top bar) surrounds a calm work area, hairline cool-grey rules do the separating, and one grotesque face carries the interface while a typed monospace is kept for call numbers and accession codes.

The mood is quiet, exact and desk-ready: dense enough for eight hours of scanning, issuing and cataloguing, restrained enough that the only strong colour on screen belongs to the books. It refuses the pale admin-dashboard default (icon-and-card grid, sage-on-cream, one sans everywhere) and is explicitly not the first Pusthakam shell, which the owner rejected as generic.

The product is offline and honest, and the design says so plainly: an offline footer in the rail, unbuilt modules that state "not available yet", no invented numbers. Recognisable with all content removed: the dark ink frame, and a white label with a coloured top band.
keyCharacteristics: Dark ink frame (rail 232px, top bar 56px) around a flat work area; both themes keep the frame darker than the work area.
The stacked call-number label is the one signature component, wherever a book appears.
Ten Dewey class colours exist only on label bands; red and amber exist only for overdue and fines.
Flat by default: hairline rules and tonal fills, no card shadows.
Text-only navigation; icons are used sparingly (search, theme, empty-state tile).
Light and dark themes are both first-class; labels stay light stock in dark theme.

rules.name: The Band-Only Rule
rules.body: The ten class colours appear only as the top band of a call-number label (and on the logo mark, which is a miniature label). They are never used for buttons, chips, charts, row accents or decoration.

rules.name: The Reserved Alarm Rule
rules.body: Red and amber mean overdue and fines, nothing else. If a screen has neither, it has no red or amber.

rules.name: The Stock Stays Light Rule
rules.body: A call-number label is light stock in both themes, like a real sticker. Never invert it for dark mode.

rules.name: The Frame Is Darker Rule
rules.body: In both themes the ink frame is darker than the work area (light: #16202e over white; dark: #090f19 over #131d2e).

rules.name: The Typed-Only Rule
rules.body: Courier Prime is for call numbers and accession codes. Never set headings, buttons or running text in it.

rules.name: The One Grotesque Rule
rules.body: Hanken Grotesk is the only interface face; hierarchy comes from weight and size, not extra families.

rules.name: The Flat Panel Rule
rules.body: Panels, buttons, chips and rows carry no shadow. Only the label sticker and the floating palette may.

dos: Do show every book with its stacked call-number label, and let the label be the loudest colour on the row.
Do keep red (#c2171d) and amber (#8a5a00) for overdue and fines only.
Do build with the CSS variable tokens in `src/styles/index.css`; give every colour a light and a dark value.
Do keep the frame darker than the work area in both themes and keep labels light stock in dark theme.
Do show unbuilt modules honestly with a "not available yet" page and a dimmed rail item.
Do keep the offline reassurance visible in the rail footer.
Do mark active navigation with fill and bold white text.
Do set call numbers and accession codes in Courier Prime and nothing else.
Do keep the UI fully offline: bundled fonts, no remote assets.
donts: Don't use Dewey class colours anywhere except a label band.
Don't add coloured side-borders or left accent stripes to rows, cards or nav items.
Don't put small uppercase eyebrow labels above headings.
Don't add shadows to panels, buttons or chips.
Don't show the Malayalam word in the interface (owner decision, 2026-11-15).
Don't return to the rejected ivory, sage and Inter sidebar look, or to an icon-and-card dashboard grid.
Don't display placeholder figures or fake records in production screens.
Don't invert a call-number label for dark theme.
